scripts.wasm:release: wasm-pack build sim --target web --release --out-dir ../pkg --out-name deskbound_sim --no-pack && npm run wasm:optimize
scripts.wasm:optimize: wasm-opt pkg/deskbound_sim_bg.wasm -Oz --strip-debug -o pkg/deskbound_sim_bg.opt.wasm && mv pkg/deskbound_sim_bg.opt.wasm pkg/deskbound_sim_bg.wasm
scripts.build: npm run wasm:release && npm run typecheck && vite build
